```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| include: false

library(ggplot2) # For making data viz
library(dplyr) # Data manipulation
library(janitor) # clean names
library(tidymodels)
library(vip) 
library(kknn) # package that contains the KNN engine
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

fd <- read.csv("~/Desktop/School/Current Classes/INFO_3200/data/winequality-red.csv", sep = ";") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(quality_cat = as.factor(ifelse(quality >= 7, "High", "Low")))
```

## Instructions

Use the `winequality-red.csv` data set to answer the following questions.

1. Split your data into training (85%) and testing (15%) samples.

```{r}
set.seed(371)

fd_split <- initial_split(fd, prop = 0.85)

fd_train <- training(fd_split)
fd_test  <- testing(fd_split)

```

2. Fit a KNN classifier to predict `purchase` from all the other variables (exclude `purchase_amt`).
```{r}
wine_knn_setup <- nearest_neighbor() |> 
  set_engine("kknn") |> 
  set_mode("classification")

wine_knn_fit <- wine_knn_setup |> 
  fit(quality_cat ~ . - quality, data = fd_train)
```


3. Compute the confusion matrix for the training sample. What is the overall accuracy.
```{r}
wine_train_pred <- wine_knn_fit |> 
  augment(fd_train)

wine_train_pred |> 
  conf_mat(truth = quality_cat, estimate = .pred_class)

my_class_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision)

wine_train_pred |> 
  my_class_metrics(truth = quality_cat, estimate = .pred_class)
```

4. Compute the sensitivity for the testing sample. What does this value tell you? 
```{r}
wine_test_pred <- wine_knn_fit |> 
  augment(fd_test)

wine_test_pred |> 
  my_class_metrics(truth = quality_cat, estimate = .pred_class)
```

5. Compare your KNN to a classification tree with respect to training and testing overall accuracy. 
```{r}
# Set up and fit the classification tree
wine_cl_setup <- decision_tree() |> 
  set_engine("rpart") |> 
  set_mode("classification")

wine_cl_fit <- wine_cl_setup |> 
  fit(quality_cat ~ . - quality, data = fd_train)

# Training accuracy for the tree
wine_train_pred_cl <- wine_cl_fit |> 
  augment(fd_train)

wine_train_pred_cl |> 
  my_class_metrics(truth = quality_cat, estimate = .pred_class)

# Testing accuracy for the tree
wine_test_pred_cl <- wine_cl_fit |> 
  augment(fd_test)

wine_test_pred_cl |> 
  my_class_metrics(truth = quality_cat, estimate = .pred_class)
```
